description: This file contains shell functions for extracting variables from a Makefile, checking for missing documentation comments for commands, and verifying extraneous documentation files. It is used for validating and maintaining documentation consistency of command-line tools and makefile variables.

methods.name: extract_variable
methods.description: Extracts the value of a variable from the Makefile and associated inline content, used to retrieve command lists like BUILT_INS, ALL_COMMANDS, and EXCLUDED_PROGRAMS.

methods.name: check_missing_docs
methods.description: Checks whether all commands are documented and linked properly in the documentation files.

methods.name: check_extraneous_docs
methods.description: Verifies that there are no documentation files for commands that are no longer present or required.
